hero.title: Platform Features
hero.subtitle: Everything you need to design, deploy, and monitor complex network topologies with SDN controllers, programmable switches, and dynamic routing protocols.

features.coreSubtitle: Industry-leading capabilities for network research, education, and development
features.advancedSubtitle: Powerful tools for professional network engineers and researchers
features.architectureSubtitle: Built with scalability, performance, and reliability in mind

topology.title: Interactive Topology Designer
topology.description: Drag-and-drop interface for creating complex network topologies with 8+ device types including hosts, switches, routers, containers, and P4 switches.

sdn.title: SDN Controller Support
sdn.description: Integrated support for multiple SDN controllers: OS-Ken, Ryu, OpenDaylight, ONOS, POX, and Floodlight with OpenFlow 1.0-1.5.

p4.title: P4 Programming
p4.description: Full P4 language support for programmable data planes with runtime compilation and deployment to P4 switches.

monitoring.title: Real-time Monitoring
monitoring.description: Comprehensive monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana dashboards tracking bandwidth, latency, packet loss, and device metrics.

protocols.title: Protocol Management
protocols.description: Support for dynamic routing protocols: OSPF, BGP, RIP, IS-IS, EIGRP, and static routes with FRRouting (FRR) integration.

webshell.title: Web Shell Access
webshell.description: Browser-based terminal access to any device in the emulation for real-time command execution and debugging.

container.title: Container Integration
container.description: Native Docker container support with custom images, environment variables, volumes, and resource limits.

snapshot.title: Snapshot & Restore
snapshot.description: Capture complete network state snapshots including device configurations, flow tables, and routing tables for later restoration.

importExport.title: Import/Export
importExport.description: Export topologies as JSON for sharing and version control. Import pre-built topologies for instant deployment.

generator.title: Topology Generator
generator.description: AI-powered topology generation with predefined patterns (Linear, Star, Tree, Mesh) and custom parameters.

deviceManager.title: Device Manager
deviceManager.description: Runtime device operations - add, remove, or modify devices in live emulations without stopping the network.

orchestrator.title: Orchestrator
orchestrator.description: Centralized orchestration service managing emulation lifecycle, resource allocation, and service coordination.

multiDb.title: Multi-Database Support
multiDb.description: PostgreSQL for relational data, MongoDB for snapshots, InfluxDB for metrics, and Redis for caching.

serviceDiscovery.title: Service Discovery
serviceDiscovery.description: Consul-based service registry for automatic service discovery and health monitoring.

microservices.title: Microservices Architecture
microservices.description: 12+ independent services for scalability and resilience

eventDriven.title: Event-Driven
eventDriven.description: RabbitMQ message broker for real-time event propagation

containerNative.title: Container-Native
containerNative.description: Fully containerized with Docker Compose orchestration

cta.title: Ready to Get Started?
cta.subtitle: Create your first network topology and experience the power of NEXUS - Network EXperimentation Unified System
